title: Pull commitments and owners out of a meeting transcript
prompt: From the fixture transcript, produce a table of every action item: owner, action, due date, and whether the owner explicitly agreed to it. Distinguish items someone accepted from items that were assigned to an absent person or left hanging without acknowledgement.
notes: Three of the seven items are suggested but never accepted, and one is assigned to someone not in the meeting. Discriminates on the accepted-vs-assigned distinction, which is the difference between a useful action list and a fictional one.
